headline_drivers: NextEra Energy agreed to buy Dominion Energy in an all-stock transaction valued at about $67 billion; reported over the weekend and driving a sharp re-rating in Dominion shares (reported 2026-05-18).

Dominion was also highlighted for strong sector momentum and investor attention around the merger, with the stock rising about 10%-12% on the news and trading near its highest level since 2022 (2026-05-18 to 2026-05-22).
summary: The market is primarily reacting to the takeover/merger headline: NextEra Energy’s reported agreement to buy Dominion Energy in an all-stock deal valued at roughly $67 billion. That is the clear catalyst behind the recent multi-day move, which is consistent with a merger-arbitrage / re-rating response rather than an earnings or operational surprise. The stock’s elevated RSI and low volume versus average suggest the move is being driven more by deal headlines and technical momentum than by fresh fundamental operating news.
